contentHtml:
Software Install & Setup

As part of our one-stop-shop computer repair services, we provide dedicated service to install and setup any software available in the market for you. Our expert professionals have a wide range of experience when it comes to software installation, testing, bench-marking and newly setup computers.

Software installation seems to be an easy task for most people who have the basic understanding on how the software installation package works and how to run them. But in the modern age of technology, some software installers are now being bundled with other third party programs that can be unintentionally installed thus making most users unaware. The most common third party programs that comes with your downloaded software are browser toolbars and helper objects (BHOs).

Software installation can be frustrating especially when you need to give so much effort on visiting each software website, downloading the setup installer, waiting for the download to finish and all the confusions on selecting the best installation option. At Computer Repairs Stretton, we offer a streamlined software setup process that does it all for you and completed in the quickest time possible. Our expert technicians exactly which is the best installation option to perfectly fit your need and opts you out of those crappy programs that you don’t need. We can also help you decide on what programs you should choose to install and why.

Benefits of our software install and setup Stretton service

Smart selection of software defaults, Our expert technicians are well experienced and always up to date about which setting is the best to optimize all your computing needs. The service also includes custom and default installation directories and 32-bit or 64-bit support to match your machine.

Support on all kinds of software, We will let you know which are the most commonly used software based on popularity in the market and what are the price range and licenses option for each software. We also give importance on offering our clients the best free software alternatives instead of expensive ones.

Support on any software version, We always offer to give our customers the latest stable version of the software they need but you are also free to choose on which version of software you want to keep.

Quick and easy installation process, Let us work for all your software install and setup needs. Instead of visiting all those various software websites, downloading each installers, selecting installation options, unchecking those unwanted and horrible stuff like bundled toolbars that you do not really want and finally waiting for the software to finish installation.

Training, We also offer one-on-one training service to help you learn and understand the functionality of the software you have wished to install.

So if you ever have problems on choosing the right software for your computing needs, call Computer Repairs Stretton at 0477 319 160 with no call out fees. Our workshop is open 7 days a week from 7am up to 10pm and even on holidays. You can be assured that your computer will be up and running with all the programs you need to be able to adapt with basic functionalities.

For all your computer and laptop repair needs, visit our repair services section and choose from the wide variety of our services.
